title: Ternary Mamba: Grouped Quantization-Aware Training of W1.58A16 State Space Models
selection_reason: Ternary Mamba applies grouped quantization-aware training with distillation from a frozen FP16 teacher to compress Mamba-2 1.3B by 3.61x (2,687 to 744 MB) for edge deployment of state-space models.
